Exercise 9. a) Between the Government and the Mountain Front (Mountains) from midnight on Sunday; After three months of clashes in the northern provinces, which according to the UN caused more than one hundred thousand displaced persons. After a round of indirect talks hosted by a neighbouring country, with the foreign minister of that country as mediator. The agreement provides for: stop to hostilities; withdrawal of both sides five kilometres from the front lines; buffer zone with international observers; political negotiations within one month. The mediator speaks of successful test and limited accidents; the army accuses armed elements of firing on its station; The Front says that government forces have not yet withdrawn from two villages. The versions are not verifiable because the observer mission has not yet arrived. Factors: The ability of the two parties to control their men on the ground and the guarantees of international actors (two previous agreements collapsed in a few weeks). Expressions: ⁧إثر⁩ · ⁧على أن⁩ · ⁧في غضون⁩ (also: ⁧على الصعيد الإنساني⁩ ). Attribution: ⁧بحسب الأمم المتحدة⁩ · ⁧أكد الوسيط⁩ · ⁧اتهم الجيش في بيان⁩ · ⁧قالت الجبهة⁩ · ⁧قال مسؤول⁩ · ⁧يرى محللون⁩ . b) Challenges: smuggling of goods and fuel; shipwrecks of migrant boats; protection of submarine cables; (later) illegal fishing. Cooperation: Memorandum on information exchange, coordination of research and rescue, training of coastguards; annual joint exercises. Limits: mistrust between the apparatuses; different laws on data protection; Southern countries complain that cooperation follows the priorities of the north (limit migration), while they need support to monitor the coasts and combat illegal fishing. Rescue: International law obliges every ship to help those in danger, but disputes over the responsibility of landing sometimes delay the arrival on the ground of survivors. Conclusion (some researchers): moving from the logic of security to that of partnership. The author speaks in the first paragraph (description of challenges) and in the final sentence; the rest is attributed to experts and researchers.
